summary: QMMM Holdings Ltd, a Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 29, 2026, attaching Exhibit 99.1 with unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the six months ended March 31, 2026. No special-situation transaction is disclosed: no stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics appear. The filing is a routine earnings release, showing revenue of $519,560 versus $1,225,912 a year earlier, a gross profit of $94,988, and a net loss of roughly $1.93 million. What to watch is operating cash burn and equity erosion, not event-driven arbitrage.
